mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pk_user_stats(user_id, points, wins, losses, draws, matches, highest_streak, updated_at) VALUES(#{userId}, #{pointsDelta}, #{isWin}, #{isLoss}, #{isDraw}, 1, #{highestStreak}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE points = GREATEST(0, points + #{pointsDelta}), wins = wins + (#{isWin} = true), losses = losses + (#{isLoss} = true), draws = draws + (#{isDraw} = true), matches = matches + 1, highest_streak = GREATEST(highest_streak, #{highestStreak}), updated_at = NOW()

choose.when: SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, s.points, s.wins, s.losses, s.draws, s.matches, CASE WHEN s.wins + s.losses + s.draws > 0 THEN ROUND(s.wins * 100.0 / (s.wins + s.losses + s.draws), 1) ELSE 0 END AS winRate, s.highest_streak AS highestStreak, COALESCE(d.net_points, 0) AS pointsToday FROM pk_user_stats s JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM pk_daily_stats WHERE stat_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND stat_date <= CURDATE() ) active ON active.user_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN pk_daily_stats d ON d.user_id = s.user_id AND d.stat_date = CURDATE() ORDER BY s.points DESC, s.wins DESC, winRate DESC, s.highest_streak DESC, s.user_id ASC

SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, s.points, s.wins, s.losses, s.draws, s.matches, CASE WHEN s.wins + s.losses + s.draws > 0 THEN ROUND(s.wins * 100.0 / (s.wins + s.losses + s.draws), 1) ELSE 0 END AS winRate, s.highest_streak AS highestStreak, COALESCE(d.net_points, 0) AS pointsToday FROM pk_user_stats s JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN pk_daily_stats d ON d.user_id = s.user_id AND d.stat_date = CURDATE() ORDER BY s.points DESC, s.wins DESC, winRate DESC, s.highest_streak DESC, s.user_id ASC
choose.otherwise: SELECT s.user_id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, s.points, s.wins, s.losses, s.draws, s.matches, CASE WHEN s.wins + s.losses + s.draws > 0 THEN ROUND(s.wins * 100.0 / (s.wins + s.losses + s.draws), 1) ELSE 0 END AS winRate, s.highest_streak AS highestStreak, COALESCE(d.net_points, 0) AS pointsToday FROM pk_user_stats s JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id JOIN pk_daily_stats d ON d.user_id = s.user_id AND d.stat_date = CURDATE() ORDER BY s.points DESC, s.wins DESC, winRate DESC, s.highest_streak DESC, s.user_id ASC

mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS userId, u.username, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, COALESCE(s.points, 0) AS pkPoints, CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.wins, 0) + COALESCE(s.losses, 0) + COALESCE(s.draws, 0) > 0 THEN ROUND(s.wins * 100.0 / (s.wins + s.losses + s.draws), 1) ELSE 0 END AS winRate FROM user u LEFT JOIN pk_user_stats s ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN pk_user_setting st ON st.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id IN #{id} AND u.enabled = true AND (st.invisible IS NULL OR st.invisible = false)
